run_distributed_pretraining: run a slurm distributed pretraining job by passing a config file path as the first argument
launch_jobs_submit_slurm: launch slurm jobs by rsyncing a codebase and submitting sbatch scripts for each job tuple
launch_jobs_custom_sbatch_args: launch slurm jobs with custom sbatch arguments like qos or account passed as keyword arguments
main_save_config_and_launch: save an omegaconf config to yaml and launch a distributed training job via launch_jobs
review_sbatch_template: review the sbatch_template string to understand slurm directives and srun command structure for distributed jobs
